product_description:
Starting your ear stretching journey should not mean piecing together a kit yourself. BodyJ4You's 37-Piece Ear Stretching Kit is a complete set, built so a first-time stretcher has everything needed to go from a fresh 14G all the way to 00G - the hardware, the aftercare and the know-how, in one box.

A Complete Kit, Not Just Hardware
Most stretching kits give you tapers and plugs and leave aftercare up to you. This one includes a premium all-natural stretching balm made with jojoba, castor and plant-based oils. The balm conditions your lobes, eases each stretch and keeps skin soft and flexible - so you are ready to stretch properly from day one, with nothing else to buy.

Premium Materials That Last
Each kit includes precision-crafted surgical stainless steel tapers and tunnels sized from 14G (1.6mm) to 00G (10mm). Surgical stainless steel is hypoallergenic, lightweight and easy to clean. Every taper has a mirror-polished surface that glides through your piercing without catching, and tunnels are polished inside and out for comfortable all-day wear - single flare with o-rings or screw fit threaded tunnels.

Beginner Friendly, By Design
Stretching takes patience. Wait four to six weeks between sizes and never force a stretch. Apply a small amount of stretching balm to your lobe before inserting your taper to reduce friction, then follow with the matching plug. Re-apply balm daily between stretches to keep lobes moisturized and ready for the next size up. Mild pressure is normal - pain is not.

More Than the Price of the Set
You get what other kits give you, and more: verified sizes, spare o-rings, premium aftercare and guidance from a brand with over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community. Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching come down to the same foundation - clean jewelry, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This kit gives you all three, plus the confidence to do it right.

product_description:
Taking your ear stretching beyond 00G requires the right tools and consistent aftercare. BodyJ4You Big Gauge Stretching Kit gives you everything you need to continue stretching safely from 00G all the way to 20mm. Each kit includes surgical stainless steel single flare tunnels and solid acrylic tapers, designed for smooth transitions between larger sizes with minimal discomfort.
Surgical stainless steel tunnels are hypoallergenic, lightweight and easy to clean, ideal for daily wear and extended stretching sessions. Solid acrylic tapers are lightweight with a perfectly smooth surface that glides through your piercing without catching or snagging, providing gradual support as you size up through bigger gauges.

BodyJ4You offers a dedicated ear stretching balm and USDA organic jojoba oil designed for gauge aftercare and daily lobe maintenance.
Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching all require the same foundation - clean jewelry, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This kit is built for experienced stretchers continuing from 00G through 13/16 inch. Men and women trust BodyJ4You for reliable gauge kits backed by over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community.
Mild pressure during a stretch is normal but pain is not. Listen to your body, take your time, and let your lobes heal fully between each size.

product_description:
Starting your ear stretching journey should not mean piecing together a kit yourself. BodyJ4You's 37-Piece Ear Stretching Kit is a complete set, built so a first-time stretcher has everything needed to go from a fresh 14G all the way to 00G - the hardware, the aftercare and the know-how, in one box.

A Complete Kit, Not Just Hardware
Most stretching kits give you tapers and plugs and leave aftercare up to you. This one includes premium USDA Organic cold-pressed jojoba oil. Jojoba is the closest natural match to your skin's own oils, so it eases each stretch and keeps your lobes soft, hydrated and flexible - you are ready to stretch properly from day one, with nothing else to buy.

Premium Materials That Last
Each kit includes precision-crafted surgical stainless steel tapers and tunnels sized from 14G (1.6mm) to 00G (10mm). Surgical stainless steel is hypoallergenic, lightweight and easy to clean. Every taper has a mirror-polished surface that glides through your piercing without catching, and tunnels are polished inside and out for comfortable all-day wear - single flare with o-rings or screw fit threaded tunnels.

Beginner Friendly, By Design
Stretching takes patience. Wait four to six weeks between sizes and never force a stretch. Apply a few drops of jojoba oil to your lobe before inserting your taper to reduce friction, then follow with the matching plug. Re-apply oil daily between stretches to keep lobes moisturized and ready for the next size up. Mild pressure is normal - pain is not.

More Than the Price of the Set
You get what other kits give you, and more: verified sizes, spare o-rings, USDA Organic aftercare and guidance from a brand with over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community. Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching come down to the same foundation - clean jewelry, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This kit gives you all three, plus the confidence to do it right.

product_description:
Starting your ear stretching journey requires the right gauge kit and a solid aftercare routine. BodyJ4You Ear Gauge Stretching Kit gives you everything you need to begin gauging safely and comfortably. Each set includes acrylic tapers, single flare acrylic plugs with o-rings, flexible double flare silicone tunnels, and USDA organic cold pressed jojoba oil sized from 14G (1.6mm) to 12mm (1/2 inch) for smooth transitions between gauge sizes with minimal discomfort.

Acrylic tapers and ear plugs are lightweight with a perfectly smooth surface that glides through your piercing without catching or snagging. Silicone ear gauges are soft, flexible and comfortable enough for all-day wear and sleeping. Both materials are hypoallergenic and easy to clean, making this gauging kit ideal for daily use and long stretching sessions. Works for earlobe stretching, septum stretching and all ear gauging styles.

Ear stretching takes patience. Wait at least four to six weeks between sizes and never force a stretch. Apply jojoba oil as gauge lube to your lobe before inserting your taper to reduce friction and support a smooth comfortable stretch. Consistent aftercare between stretches keeps your lobes moisturized, flexible and ready for the next size up. Pure golden jojoba oil mimics your skin's natural oils for deep hydration without clogging pores. Pairs with ear stretching balm for complete gauging care.

Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching all require the same foundation - clean earring gauges, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This gauge starter kit is built for beginners starting at 14g earrings and stretchers sizing up to 12mm. Men and women trust BodyJ4You for reliable ear gauge sets backed by over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community.

Mild pressure during a stretch is normal but pain is not. Listen to your body, take your time, and let your lobes heal fully between each size. With the right tools and consistent care, stretching can be a safe and rewarding experience.

BodyJ4You's 37-Piece Ear Stretching Kit is a complete set, built so a first-time stretcher has everything needed to go from a fresh 14G all the way to 00G - the hardware, the aftercare and the know-how, in one box.

More Than the Price of the Set
You get what other kits give you, and more: verified sizes, spare o-rings, premium aftercare and guidance from a brand with over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community. Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching come down to the same foundation - clean jewelry, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This kit gives you all three, plus the confidence to do it right.

bullet_point: ORGANIC JOJOBA OIL FOR PIERCINGS: USDA Certified Organic, 100% Pure Cold Pressed Golden Jojoba Oil in a 5ml (0.17 Fl Oz) Dropper Bottle, TSA Friendly Travel Size. Hexane Free, Unrefined, Vegan and Cruelty Free. Fits a Purse, Gym Bag or Piercing Kit for On the Go Care.

EAR STRETCHING OIL AND GAUGE AFTERCARE: A Slick, Lightweight Ear Stretching Aftercare Oil That Helps Tapers and Plugs Glide In With Less Friction. Ear Gauge Moisturizer That Keeps Stretched Lobes Soft. For Every Gauge Size, Dead Stretching and Septum Stretching.

PIERCING AFTERCARE FOR ALL BODY PIERCINGS: Jojoba Oil for Piercings That Moisturizes the Skin Around New or Healing Piercings. Use on Ear, Nose, Septum, Cartilage, Tragus, Helix, Daith, Conch, Lip, Navel and Nipple Piercings. Ear Piercing Moisturizer for Dry Pierced Ears.

HOW DO YOU USE JOJOBA OIL ON PIERCINGS: After Cleaning, Apply 2 to 3 Drops to the Piercing or Stretched Lobe and Gently Massage In. For Gauges, Coat the Taper or Plug Before Inserting. Use Morning and Night. Absorbs Fast With No Greasy Residue. Gentle and Safe for Sensitive Skin.

ONE INGREDIENT, NOTHING ADDED: Only Organic Jojoba Oil, With No Preservatives, Fillers, Fragrance or Additives. Pairs With BodyJ4You Saline Aftercare Spray and Ear Stretching Balm for a Complete Routine. Patch Test First, External Use Only.
product_description:
BodyJ4You Organic Jojoba Oil is USDA certified organic, 100% pure, cold pressed golden jojoba oil for piercing care and ear stretching, in a 5ml (0.17 fl oz) dropper bottle, tsa friendly travel size. One ingredient, nothing added.

Ear Stretching Oil: Stretched lobes need steady moisture to stay soft and flexible. Coat tapers, plugs or tunnels with a few drops before inserting so they glide in with less friction, and massage it into the lobe between stretches. Works for every gauge size, from your first stretch to large gauges, dead stretching and septum stretching.

Piercing Aftercare Oil: Jojoba oil is close to the skin's own oils, so it absorbs quickly without a greasy film and is gentle on sensitive skin. Use it as a piercing aftercare oil to moisturize the skin around new and healing ear, nose, septum, cartilage, tragus, helix, daith, conch, lip, navel and nipple piercings, or as an ear moisturizer for dry pierced ears.

How to Use: Clean the piercing with saline spray first, then apply 2 to 3 drops and gently massage in. For gauges, apply before inserting jewelry. Use morning and night. A little goes a long way.

What Is Inside: USDA certified organic jojoba oil, cold pressed, unrefined and hexane free. Vegan and cruelty free, with no preservatives, fillers, fragrance or additives. Pairs with BodyJ4You Saline Aftercare Spray and Ear Stretching Balm. Patch test first and use externally only.
directions: Give Your Earlobes a Gentle Massage with a Small Amount of Natural Jojoba Oil. Wax Will Thicken Lobes While Assisting in Maintaining Healthy, Hydrated Skin. Please Remember to Be Patient with Your Body as It Recovers.
safety_warning: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue if negative reaction or redness occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
ingredients: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil

VERIFIED SIZES, NO GUESSWORK: Tapers and Tunnels With O-Rings Included - 14G (1.6mm), 12G (2mm), 10G (2.4mm), 8G (3.2mm), 6G (4mm), 4G (5mm), 2G (6mm), 0G (8mm), 00G (10mm). Screw Fit Threaded Flesh Tunnels Unscrew at One End - Easily Insert Into Your Ear and Screw Back Securely

HEALTHY STRETCHING NEEDS AFTERCARE: Stretching Without Proper Aftercare Can Lead to Dryness, Irritation and Slow Progress. Pair This Kit With BodyJ4You Organic Jojoba Oil or Ear Stretching Balm to Keep Lobes Soft, Conditioned and Comfortable as You Size Up Through Every Gauge

HOW DO I STRETCH MY EARS SAFELY: Apply Gauge Oil or Balm to a Clean Healed Lobe, Then Slide the Taper Through Gradually and Follow With the Matching Plug. Re-Apply Aftercare Daily and Wait 4-6 Weeks Before Sizing Up. Mild Pressure Is Normal - Pain Means Stop, Patience Wins

TRUSTED QUALITY FOR DAILY WEAR: Hypoallergenic Surgical Stainless Steel With a Mirror-Polished Surface for Smooth Comfortable All-Day Wear. Lightweight, Durable and Easy to Clean. Precision-Crafted Tapers Give a Smooth Transition Between Every Gauge Size for Beginner Stretchers
product_description:
Starting your ear stretching journey takes the right tools and a steady, patient approach. BodyJ4You's 36-Piece Ear Stretching Kit gives a first-time stretcher a complete set of hardware - every gauge size from a fresh 14G all the way to 00G, with no half-size gaps to fill in later.

A Complete Set of Sizes
This kit is built so you never have to hunt for the next size mid-journey. Precision-crafted surgical stainless steel tapers and tunnels are sized from 14G (1.6mm) to 00G (10mm), each one ready when you are. Spare o-rings are included so your jewelry stays secure from your first stretch through your goal size.

Premium Materials That Last
Surgical stainless steel is hypoallergenic, lightweight and easy to clean. Every taper has a mirror-polished surface that glides through your piercing without catching, and tunnels are polished inside and out for comfortable all-day wear - single flare with secure o-rings or screw fit threaded tunnels. Built for daily wear, built to last through every size up.

Aftercare Is Not Optional
Stretching without proper aftercare leads to dryness, irritation and slow progress. Apply a conditioning oil or balm to your lobe before inserting your taper, then follow with the matching plug. Pair this kit with BodyJ4You Organic Jojoba Oil or Ear Stretching Balm to keep lobes soft, conditioned and comfortable between sizes. Re-apply daily and wait four to six weeks between stretches - mild pressure is normal, but pain is not.

Beginner Friendly, Built on Experience
Dead stretching, taper stretching and lobe stretching all come down to the same foundation - clean jewelry, proper lubrication and gradual progression. This kit gives you the full verified size range and the step-by-step guidance to do it right, so you can stretch with confidence from day one. Men and women trust BodyJ4You, backed by over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community.

product_description:
These BodyJ4You flat back earrings keep ear and face styling clean and easy. The set includes three internally threaded 16G studs with a flat back and a single shiny CZ crystal at the front for a secure, low-profile look. As a cartilage and stud earrings set for women and men, the pieces work across lobe, cartilage, tragus, helix, conch, labret, lip, Monroe and Medusa placements. Made of 316L surgical stainless steel that is hypoallergenic and resistant to tarnishing.

Three bar lengths fine tune the fit. Choose 6 mm for snug placements, 8 mm for standard positions, and 10 mm for thicker tissue or a stacked layout. CZ sizes step from 2 mm to 3 mm to 4 mm. The flat back sits smooth against skin to reduce irritation, and the internally threaded screw top holds each stud secure so it will not loosen or catch on hair and clothing.

Build a clean earring stack by lining two studs along the lobe and setting the third at the tragus or helix for a balanced look. Step lengths from 6 to 8 to 10 mm to create a gentle rise from lobe to cartilage, or mirror a single stud in both ears for symmetry. Pair clear crystals with silvertone for work or rose goldtone with pink crystals for weekends.

The flat back design rests comfortably for sleep, workouts and behind headphones, which makes this a practical everyday cartilage and helix earring set for sensitive ears. The hypoallergenic surgical steel holds its color and resists tarnish through daily wear.

To wear, insert the flat back post from behind, place the CZ top on the front and turn clockwise until snug, using tweezers for a firm grip and avoiding overtightening. Rinse with mild soap and warm water, dry completely, and check the threading for a firm seat before heading out.

BodyJ4You is backed by over 20 years in the piercing and body jewelry community. Each set is quality checked before shipping. Our customer service team is available seven days a week for your product questions.

product_description:
A piercing bump is one of the most common reasons a new piercing stops feeling like a good idea. It shows up as a raised red or purple mark beside the jewelry, it takes weeks to form, and it takes weeks to settle. BodyJ4You Piercing Bump Solution is a concentrated botanical oil built for that moment, gentle enough for sensitive skin on a brand new piercing or one you have had for years.

Where a rinse stops: an ear piercing cleaner or sea salt spray keeps the surface clean, which matters, but it is a rinse. This oil is the targeted second step. Jojoba, grape seed, rosemary, lavender, frankincense and vitamin E work together to soften how a keloid bump looks and feels, calm visible redness, and even out the texture of the skin around the jewelry. The lightweight blend absorbs fast and leaves no greasy film.

Where people use it: nose ring bumps, earring bumps and irritation around cartilage, industrial, septum, belly button, navel, nipple, dermal, eyebrow and lip piercings. The precision glass dropper puts each drop exactly on the spot instead of running down your neck.

How to use it: wash your hands, place 2 to 3 drops on the bump and the skin around it, and massage gently. Do that 2 to 3 times a day, every day. This is not an overnight fix. Most people see a visible difference between two and four weeks, and the ones who see the most change are the ones who do not skip days. One 0.33 fl oz bottle covers roughly a month at that pace, so reorder monthly or keep a spare from the multipack.

What is in it and what is not: a short list of plant oils plus vitamin E. No alcohol, no parabens, no harsh additives. Lab tested, safety sealed, vegan and cruelty free. Free from preservatives and fillers. Patch test on your inner wrist before first use and keep it away from your eyes. For external use only. Pairs with the BodyJ4You Piercing Aftercare Spray for the full routine, from a team trusted by the piercing community for over 20 years.
directions: Apply drops to target area twice daily. Results may take weeks to become visible, please be patient with your body as it recovers.

product_description:
A piercing bump is one of the most common reasons a new piercing stops feeling like a good idea. It shows up as a raised red or purple mark beside the jewelry, it takes weeks to form, and it takes weeks to settle. BodyJ4You Piercing Bump Solution is a concentrated botanical oil built for that moment, gentle enough for sensitive skin on a brand new piercing or one you have had for years.

Where a rinse stops: an ear piercing cleaner or sea salt spray keeps the surface clean, which matters, but it is a rinse. This oil is the targeted second step. Jojoba, grape seed, rosemary, lavender, frankincense and vitamin E work together to soften how a keloid bump looks and feels, calm visible redness, and even out the texture of the skin around the jewelry. The lightweight blend absorbs fast and leaves no greasy film.

Where people use it: nose ring bumps, earring bumps and irritation around cartilage, industrial, septum, belly button, navel, nipple, dermal, eyebrow and lip piercings. The precision glass dropper puts each drop exactly on the spot instead of running down your neck.

How to use it: wash your hands, place 2 to 3 drops on the bump and the skin around it, and massage gently. Do that 2 to 3 times a day, every day. This is not an overnight fix. Most people see a visible difference between two and four weeks, and the ones who see the most change are the ones who do not skip days. One 0.33 fl oz bottle covers roughly a month at that pace, so reorder monthly or keep a spare from the multipack.

What is in it and what is not: a short list of plant oils plus vitamin E. No alcohol, no parabens, no harsh additives. Lab tested, safety sealed, vegan and cruelty free. Free from preservatives and fillers. Patch test on your inner wrist before first use and keep it away from your eyes. For external use only. Pairs with the BodyJ4You Piercing Aftercare Spray for the full routine, from a team trusted by the piercing community for over 20 years.
directions: Apply drops to target area twice daily. Results may take weeks to become visible, please be patient with your body as it recovers.
safety_warning: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue if negative reaction or redness occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

product_description:

Organic tea tree oil is pre-blended with organic fractionated coconut oil, also called MCT, at a skin-friendly ratio, so there is no second bottle to buy, no measuring and no dilution math.

Work it around nails, cuticles and toenails for tidy well-groomed edges, and use it on feet, toes and heels for a post-workout refresh before socks go on. Amber glass protects the blend from sunlight so it keeps its character to the last drop. Choose the size that matches your routine, from a travel bottle through to a bulk pump bottle for daily whole-body use.

Two ingredients and nothing else: organic tea tree oil (Melaleuca alternifolia) and organic fractionated coconut oil. No parabens, no mineral oil, no dyes and no synthetic fragrance. USDA Organic, vegan, cruelty free, hexane free, small batch filled and safety sealed.

It pairs naturally with BodyJ4You Organic Jojoba Oil for a full face, body and nail routine. Shake well before each use and patch test on your inner forearm. For external topical use only.

product_description:
BodyJ4You Peppermint Essential Oil is different from the raw peppermint oil that fills most of the aisle. It comes pre-diluted in organic MCT coconut oil at a skin-friendly ratio, ready to use straight from the bottle. No measuring, no separate carrier oil to buy, and none of the dilution math an undiluted essential oil asks of you. Neat peppermint can burn on skin - pre-dilution takes that worry off the table.

For Cooling and Energizing: Smooth two to three drops onto temples, the back of the neck, shoulders or tired feet and feel the fresh menthol cool set in. The light MCT base spreads thin, absorbs quickly and leaves no greasy residue, so it works across face, body and feet. Peppermint is the scent people reach for to feel awake.

For Post-Workout and Busy Days: Massage a few drops onto muscles after activity or trace along the neck and shoulders for a cool, refreshed feeling. Use it morning or midday for a quick energizing reset.

Four Sizes, One Blend: The same USDA Organic pre-diluted formula comes in 1 fl oz for a purse or carry-on, 2 fl oz for everyday use, 4 fl oz when peppermint becomes a daily habit, and a 16 fl oz pump for studios, gyms and family routines. Start small, then size up once it earns a place in the routine.

Made for Skin, Not for Diffusers: Pre-diluted in MCT coconut oil, this blend is built for direct topical use, not for diffusers. It pairs naturally with BodyJ4You Organic Jojoba Oil and our Lavender pre-diluted oil.

Two Clean Ingredients: Organic Peppermint Oil and Organic Fractionated Coconut Oil (MCT), and nothing else. The fresh peppermint scent comes from real organic oil - no parabens, no mineral oil, no dyes, no synthetic fragrance. USDA Organic, vegan, cruelty free and hexane free. Amber glass guards potency and the dropper gives controlled application. Shake well and patch test on your inner forearm first. For external topical use only.
directions: Adults and children 12 years and older. For external topical use only. Shake well before each use. Dispense 2-3 drops onto clean skin and massage in. Apply to temples, back of the neck, shoulders, muscles or feet. Use morning or anytime a cool refresh is wanted. A little goes a long way, so start with fewer drops and add as needed. Patch test on the inner forearm and wait 24 hours before first use. Avoid contact with eyes, lips, inner nose and other mucous membranes. Do not apply to broken or irritated skin. Wash hands after use. Not for use on children under 12. If irritation occurs, stop use. Keep out of reach of children. Store tightly capped away from direct sunlight and heat. Not intended for diffusers.
safety_warning: External use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid eyes and mucous membranes; rinse with water if contact occurs. Patch test before first use on inner forearm. product_description:
BodyJ4You Eucalyptus Essential Oil is USDA Organic eucalyptus pre-diluted in pure MCT coconut oil, so it is ready to use straight from the bottle. There is nothing to measure, nothing to mix, and no separate carrier oil to buy or blend. Just open the amber glass bottle, draw up the precision dropper, and apply. The crisp eucalyptus scent and light cooling sensation make it a simple everyday pick-me-up for skin that feels tired, warm, or dull.

For Face and Skin: Pat 2-3 drops gently onto clean skin for a refreshing, energizing feel. The MCT base absorbs fast, feels lightweight, and does not leave a heavy greasy film, so it works in the morning before a busy day or in the evening as part of a calm wind-down routine.

For Post Workout Massage: Work a few drops into shoulders, calves, and the back of the neck after training. The cooling eucalyptus feel and smooth glide make it an easy massage oil for gym bags, sports kits, and travel pouches, and the secure cap keeps it leak-resistant on the go.

For Body Care: Sweep it over arms and legs after a shower as a light body oil, or dab it on temples and pulse points whenever you want a clean, fresh reset in the middle of a long day.

Why BodyJ4You: This is a clean two ingredient formula - USDA Organic eucalyptus and MCT coconut oil. It is vegan, cruelty free, hexane free, and made with no alcohol and no fillers. Every bottle is small batch filled, safety sealed, and packaged in amber glass that protects the fresh natural aroma. It is available in 1, 2, 4, and 16 Fl Oz sizes, so you can start small or stock up for daily use, and it pairs perfectly with BodyJ4You Lavender, Peppermint, and Tea Tree pre-diluted oils to build a complete topical oil routine for skin, body, and massage. BodyJ4You has served skin care and body care customers for more than 20 years, and this blend is held to the same standard: simple, honest ingredients that are easy to use every single day.

ingredients: Organic EUCALYPTUS Oil (Lavandula Angustifolia), Organic Fractionated Coconut Oil (Caprylic/Capric Triglycerides)
